description: This file provides utility functions for parsing subtitle files in SRT and VTT formats, converting them into subtitle item objects with timing information, as well as a utility for generating random IDs.

methods.name: parseTimeToMs(t)
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string in 'hh:mm:ss,ms' or 'hh:mm:ss.ms' format to milliseconds.

methods.name: parseSrt(text, defaultCharacterId = 'default')
methods.description: Parses an SRT subtitle string into an array of subtitle items with id, characterId, text, start, and end properties.

methods.name: parseVtt(text, defaultCharacterId = 'default')
methods.description: Parses a WebVTT subtitle string into subtitle items, utilizing the parseSrt function after cleaning header lines.

methods.name: cryptoRandomId()
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random ID string, or falls back to a less secure method if crypto is unavailable.
